elements.label: Figure 1.13
elements.title: Foreign Direct Investment and Remittances in Low- and Middle-Income Countries (Excluding China), 2000–25
elements.description: The chart compares FDI and remittance flows to low- and middle-income countries excluding China from 2000 to 2025. Remittances rise substantially and exceed FDI by a widening margin after the early 2010s, while FDI fluctuates. Both series are highest in 2025; remittances are lowest in 2000 and FDI is lowest around 2003.
elements.notes:
Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
Note: FDI = foreign direct investment.
